name: EmbedUtils
install_msg:
EmbedUtils 3.1 uses the EmbedCreator builder.
`[p]embed builder` or `[p]embed create title: Hello`.
Store, Update stored, Event embed, and Server event sit under the builder.
`[p]embed update` overwrites a saved embed. `[p]embed event ... True` also creates a Discord server event.
short: Modern embed creator: slash, buttons, modals, storage.
description: New EmbedUtils built from the Phen and AAA3A designs. Hybrid commands, autocomplete, message context menus, modal builder, dropdown posting, native webhooks, and automatic one-time import of legacy stored embeds. No AAA3A_utils dependency.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the Discord user ID of anyone who saves an embed, plus the embed payload, lock flag, and usage count. A user data deletion request removes every embed they authored.
